limitations: Regimes use closed hourly OHLCV features, not historical order-book depth.
The candidate list is deliberately small and interpretable to limit multiple testing.
A historical pass would still require fresh shadow outcomes before runtime activation.

protocol.input: exact frozen OKX hourly target router plus causal valid levels
protocol.stability: at least 40 flagged development trades, >=10 in at least two years, no informative year below 0.80 stop-rate lift
